answer: Orchard Layered Bond: each agent builds orchard tiers: seedling 50 locked 5 epochs, grove 100 locked 10, summit 200 locked 20. Each tier needs a fresh whisper seal from the summit auditor; the auditor replays seals each epoch, burning all tiers on a reused seal or a rented-tier ring. Filing costs 20 per tier, so 1,000 fakes lock 350,000 plus 60,000 fees vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once, pay 60, and get 350 back as tiers mature.
